alerts.summary: Frances Katzen, founder of The Katzen Team and a top broker at Douglas Elliman in New York City, discussed the current dynamics of the housing market, highlighting a pronounced K-shaped trend. While overall housing activity has slowed, the high-end segment in Manhattan is experiencing significant growth, with contract signings up 39% year-over-year in October and properties priced between $3 million and $5 million up 27%. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

By the end of 2025, the U.S. power system had operational battery storage capacity of 43.6 gigawatts (GW). During the first six months of 2026, operators added another 8.3 GW of battery storage capacity, reaching nearly 52 GW of nameplate battery storage capacity, based on our latest Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory.
